name: Eternity
source:
Eternity is a short visual novel experience featuring Neo and Aden! Neo has been cursed with Vampirism and has recently started a new century. On his quest to discover who this version of himself is, he stumbles across Aden - a University student who's struggling with the path that's been laid out for his future.

Follow them on a night of self-discovery.

[From [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/eternity]Itch.io[/url]]
